Scenario fixture: svg-text-alternative-present (“<svg> must provide a text alternative”)

This file includes edge cases to test eligibility, "intent" gating, and whole-rule outcomes. Each test svg has a stable id of the form svg_case_XX.

A. Baseline (applicable when intent is present)

01 — FAIL: role="img" with no title/desc and no ARIA name
svg Missing all supported text alternative mechanisms.
02 — PASS: role="img" with non-empty <title>
svg <title> provides the alternative.
03 — FAIL: role="img" with only <desc> (no <title>/ARIA name) — verified against SVG-AAM spec §7.1: desc only ever contributes to the accessible DESCRIPTION, never the NAME
svg <desc> alone does not provide an accessible name; still applicable since desc signals intent.
04 — PASS: role="img" with aria-label
svg aria-label provides the alternative.
05 — PASS: role="img" with aria-labelledby
Menu svg aria-labelledby provides the alternative.

B. aria-hidden eligibility

06 — FAIL: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0), still applicable; unnamed
svg tabbable overrides aria-hidden eligibility; missing text alternative.
07 — FAIL: aria-hidden but IDREF-referenced by eligible element; unnamed
Host references svg via aria-labelledby.
svg IDREF reference should keep svg eligible; missing alternative.
08 — NOT APPLICABLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable (ineligible)
svg Ineligible per helper; should not produce an occurrence.

C. role=presentation / none

09 — FAIL: role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0), applicable; unnamed
svg Focusable presentation svg is evaluated and fails when unnamed.
10 — FAIL: role=none but focusable (tabindex=0), applicable; unnamed
svg Focusable role=none svg is evaluated and fails when unnamed.
11 — NOT APPLICABLE: role=presentation not focusable (excluded by rule)
svg Excluded by rule; should not contribute to pass/fail.

D. Guardrails: conditions that should NOT exclude eligibility

12 — FAIL: opacity:0, still eligible; unnamed
svg Opacity does not exclude; missing alternative fails.
13 — PASS: offscreen but has title
svg Offscreen does not exclude; title passes.
14 — PASS: zero-size container but has aria-label
svg Zero-size does not exclude; aria-label passes.

E. Non-composed / inert / CSS-hidden (ineligible)

15 — FAIL: offscreen + unnamed is still eligible and applicable
svg Offscreen is not a visibility exclusion; missing alternative fails.
16 — NOT APPLICABLE: inert subtree is ineligible
svg Ineligible per helper.
17 — NOT APPLICABLE: inside <template> is not composed
tpl Template contents are non-composed.
18 — NOT APPLICABLE: display:none ineligible
svg display:none makes it ineligible.
19 — NOT APPLICABLE: visibility:hidden ineligible
svg visibility:hidden makes it ineligible.

F. Intent gating (not evaluated without signals)

20 — NOT APPLICABLE: decorative inline svg with no signals (no role/name/title/desc/focus)
svg No intent signal; skipped by rule to avoid noisy false positives.

G. <title> DOM-position rule (<desc> never satisfies the name requirement regardless of position — see section A case 03)

21 — FAIL: role="img" with <title> that is NOT the first child element
svg A <title> that isn't the first child element is not read as the accessible name.
22 — FAIL: role="img" with <desc> as the first child element — still doesn't count as a name, regardless of position
svg <desc> never provides an accessible name, even as the first child.
23 — FAIL: role="img" with empty <title> first child, <desc> immediately second — desc still doesn't count as a name
svg Empty <title> provides no name; the <desc> that follows never counts as one either.
24 — FAIL: role="img" with <desc> that is neither first child nor immediately after <title>
svg Already failed even before this fix — desc-as-name was position-gated, and now never counts as a name at any position.
25 — FAIL: role="graphics-symbol" with no title/desc and no aria name
svg role="graphics-symbol" is applicability intent, same as role="img".
26 — FAIL: role="graphics-document" with no title/desc and no aria name
svg role="graphics-document" is applicability intent, same as role="img".

End of fixture.
